verdict.rationale: Orama Cloud documentation describes a 'data source' abstraction for ingesting sets of documents (implying some built-in ingestion mechanism beyond manual SDK calls), but the evidence pack never names an official crawler, sitemap importer, or specific third-party connectors (e.g., web crawler, CMS, Elasticsearch, etc.). The open-source library's actual indexing API (insert/insertMultiple) is manual, not connector-based. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of a website crawler or named connector integrations, hands-on/independent confirmation of connector usage.
